canDoYue: 你識問糧單漏咗三月十二個鐘加班，因為過咗二十五號截數，下個月先出，稅同強積金會一齊調整。
canDoEn: Ask why twelve hours of March overtime are missing, hear that they missed the payroll deadline, and confirm they will be on next month's payslip with tax and MPF adjusted.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Hi Niles, do you have a minute? I think my overtime is missing from this month's payslip.
dialogue.glossYue: 你好 Niles，得唔得閒？我覺得今個月糧單漏咗我嘅加班。
dialogue.say: Hi Niles, do you have a minute? I think my overtime is missing from this month's payslip.

dialogue.speaker: niles
dialogue.text: Let me check. You did twelve hours of overtime in March, right?
dialogue.glossYue: 等我查。你三月做咗十二個鐘加班，係嗎？
dialogue.say: Let me check. You did twelve hours of overtime in March, right?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Yes, twelve hours. My manager approved them on the twenty-eighth.
dialogue.glossYue: 係，十二個鐘。我上司二十八號批咗。
dialogue.say: Yes, twelve hours. My manager approved them on the twenty-eighth.

dialogue.speaker: niles
dialogue.text: I see. That was after the payroll deadline on the twenty-fifth, so they weren't included.
dialogue.glossYue: 明白。計糧截數日係二十五號，所以嗰啲鐘冇計入。
dialogue.say: I see. That was after the payroll deadline on the twenty-fifth, so they weren't included.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Oh, OK. Will I get paid for them next month?
dialogue.glossYue: 哦，好。下個月會唔會出呢筆？
dialogue.say: Oh, OK. Will I get paid for them next month?

dialogue.speaker: niles
dialogue.text: Yes, they'll be on your April payslip. Your tax and MPF will be adjusted too.
dialogue.glossYue: 會，會出喺你四月嘅糧單。稅同強積金都會一齊調整。
dialogue.say: Yes, they'll be on your April payslip. Your tax and MPF will be adjusted too.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Great. Could you send me an email to confirm that?
dialogue.glossYue: 好。可唔可以發封電郵確認？
dialogue.say: Great. Could you send me an email to confirm that?

dialogue.speaker: niles
dialogue.text: Sure, I'll email you this afternoon.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以，我今日下晝電郵畀你。
dialogue.say: Sure, I'll email you this afternoon.
